description: This file declares the FullscreenTexture class, which is a test sample for Vulkan fullscreen texture rendering within the Cuttlefish project. It includes class methods for setup, cleanup, swapchain management, and frame recording, along with private members related to Vulkan objects such as render passes, framebuffers, shaders, and pipelines.

classes.name: FullscreenTexture
classes.description: A test sample class for rendering a fullscreen texture using Vulkan in the Cuttlefish project.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of FullscreenTexture wrapped in a Result.

methods.name: StartUp
methods.description: Initializes resources needed for the fullscreen texture rendering.

methods.name: CreateSwapchainDependents
methods.description: Creates Vulkan objects dependent on the swapchain.

methods.name: DestroySwapchainDependents
methods.description: Destroys Vulkan objects dependent on the swapchain.

methods.name: RecordFrame
methods.description: Records commands to render a frame with the fullscreen texture.
